title: Non-technical (behavioral) interview questions for software engineers - SWE interview questions
description:
If you have a SWE interview coming up make sure you're prepared for the non-technical questions. These are equally important these days since companies like Facebook and Google want well-rounded candidates who can work well in a team. 

Tony, a fellow YouTuber, bravely volunteered to do a live mock interview with me where we practiced behavioral interview questions and I gave him feedback on his answers. It was a live webinar so we also took questions from the audience on Zoom. Now you can practice these questions on your own and use my feedback to help shape your answers.

Please check out Tony's YouTube channel: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCYnDDv8EZS7UdLLeqssxYuw
